unit.why: A Besht saying followed by a narrative: on a journey with his disciples he says the wagon driver sinned overnight, and they watch until the driver gives himself away.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the heading 'מענין עולם הבא', which belongs to the next division.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי בשם הה״ק רבינו הבעש״ט ז״ל
stories.summary_en: The Besht teaches that a sin done at night is unknowingly confessed by the sinner's mouth the next day; on a journey he tells his disciples that their wagon driver lay with his wife while she was niddah, and at an inn the driver says of an unimmersed cup 'what does it matter that it was not immersed,' confirming the Besht's words.
